notes.name: Nenev
notes.legend: Dormant volcano. Height: 8872 ft.

notes.name: Hot Springs of Oberkengen
notes.legend: A geothermal springs with naturally heated water that provide relaxation and medicinal benefits. Average temperature is 48°C.

notes.name: Cango Healing Spring
notes.legend: This legendary water source is whispered about in ancient tales and believed to possess mystical properties. The spring emanates crystal-clear water, shimmering with an otherworldly iridescence that sparkles even in the dimmest light.

notes.name: Herdorf — iron mining town
notes.legend: Herdorf is a mining town of 919 people just nearby the iron mine.

notes.name: Waldstein Bridge
notes.legend: An old crossing of the Onautachlin Fork, rarely used since the drying up of local trade.

notes.name: The Proud Tavern
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious jugged pudding with bright sap is served here.

notes.name: The Black Falcon
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside inn. Delicious pan-fried olives with brown beer is served here.

notes.name: The Dark Hare
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious spit-roasted hare with cold mead is served here.

notes.name: The Good Tavern
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious braised chicken with amber spirits is served here.

notes.name: Fisch Lighthouse
notes.legend: A lighthouse to serve as a beacon for ships in the open sea.
